package.name: moveit2_extended_core
package.description:
The Objective/Behavior layer for MoveIt 2: a BehaviorContext, the Behavior base classes, the pluginlib loader seam, and the Objective server that loads Behavior plugins and runs BehaviorTree XML "Objectives".
Built against BehaviorTree.CPP v3.8 because that is what Nav2 pulls into this system; v3 and v4 share the namespace BT with incompatible layouts, so a process linking both corrupts its heap rather than failing to link. Version-specific spellings are confined to bt_compat.hpp.
